intent: Unit tests: Day-Off Index window settings, partial weeks, average and breakdown

edits.new_content:
version: 2
models:
- name: fct_day_off_index_terms
  description: 'The Day-Off Index breakdown: one row per search phrase, with its average weekly US search
    interest over the current window, over the same weeks a year earlier, and the percent change.'
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        grain:
        - term
        population:
          rule: Every phrase in the Trends snapshot the index reads (stg_trends__weekly).
          parent:
            model: stg_trends__weekly
            key:
              term: term
        assumptions:
        - decision: What the index compares
          chosen: average weekly interest over the current window vs the same weeks 52 weeks earlier,
            per phrase
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: average daily search interest 1-15 Nov 2026 vs 1-15 Nov 2025, weekly is fine
            over the 2-week window; configurable start, end and number of weeks'
          column: pct_change
        - decision: Partial or missing weeks
          chosen: excluded from the averages; the change is NULL unless both windows are complete
          evidence: default
          detail: a week still filling in would understate its average
          column: pct_change
        - decision: Week alignment
          chosen: 52 weeks back (364 days), so both windows start on a Sunday like Google's weeks
          evidence: default
          detail: 'canonical: 1-14 Nov 2026 vs 2-15 Nov 2025'
          column: prior_start_week
  columns:
  - name: term
    description: The search phrase.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: key
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: geo
    description: US.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: batch_id
    description: The Trends pull the values come from.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: span_start
    description: First day of the request span.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: span_end
    description: Last day of the request span.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: current_start_week
    description: Sunday of the first week of the current window.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: current_end_week
    description: Sunday of the last week of the current window.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: prior_start_week
    description: Sunday of the first comparison week (weeks_back earlier).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: prior_end_week
    description: Sunday of the last comparison week.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: weeks
    description: Weeks in each window.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
          unit: count
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: current_weeks_found
    description: Complete weeks found in the current window.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
          unit: count
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: prior_weeks_found
    description: Complete weeks found in the comparison window.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
          unit: count
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: current_avg_interest
    description: Average weekly search interest, current window.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: NULL when no complete week of the window is loaded
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: index (0-100, relative within one phrase's request)
  - name: prior_avg_interest
    description: Average weekly search interest, same weeks a year earlier.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: NULL when no complete week of the window is loaded
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: index (0-100, relative within one phrase's request)
  - name: pct_change
    description: Year-over-year change of the phrase's average weekly search interest, in percent (40
      = +40%).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: 'NULL unless every week of both windows is loaded and complete: unavailable, never
            zero'
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: percent
unit_tests:
- name: terms_start_and_end_week
  model: fct_day_off_index_terms
  description: 'Start + end week: averages only the window''s weeks, compares 52 weeks back.'
  overrides:
    vars:
      day_off_index_start_week: '2026-11-01'
      day_off_index_end_week: '2026-11-08'
      day_off_index_weeks_back: 52
  given:
  - input: ref('stg_trends__weekly')
    rows:
    - term: call in sick
      geo: US
      batch_id: b1
      span_start: '2025-11-01'
      span_end: '2026-11-15'
      week_start: '2025-10-26'
      interest: 99
      is_partial: false
    - term: call in sick
      geo: US
      batch_id: b1
      span_start: '2025-11-01'
      span_end: '2026-11-15'
      week_start: '2025-11-02'
      interest: 40
      is_partial: false
    - term: call in sick
      geo: US
      batch_id: b1
      span_start: '2025-11-01'
      span_end: '2026-11-15'
      week_start: '2025-11-09'
      interest: 60
      is_partial: false
    - term: call in sick
      geo: US
      batch_id: b1
      span_start: '2025-11-01'
      span_end: '2026-11-15'
      week_start: '2026-11-01'
      interest: 70
      is_partial: false
    - term: call in sick
      geo: US
      batch_id: b1
      span_start: '2025-11-01'
      span_end: '2026-11-15'
      week_start: '2026-11-08'
      interest: 80
      is_partial: false
    - term: call in sick
      geo: US
      batch_id: b1
      span_start: '2025-11-01'
      span_end: '2026-11-15'
      week_start: '2026-11-15'

  expect:
    rows:
    - term: call in sick

      current_weeks_found: 2
      prior_weeks_found: 2
      current_avg_interest: 75.0
      prior_avg_interest: 50.0
      pct_change: 50.0
- name: terms_start_and_number_of_weeks
  model: fct_day_off_index_terms

  overrides:

    - term: sick day
      geo: US
      batch_id: b1
      span_start: '2025-11-01'
      span_end: '2026-11-15'
      week_start: '2025-11-02'

    - term: sick day
      geo: US
      batch_id: b1
      span_start: '2025-11-01'
      span_end: '2026-11-15'
      week_start: '2025-11-09'

    - term: sick day
      geo: US

    - term: sick day

    - term: sick day
      geo: US
      batch_id: b1
      span_start: '2025-11-01'
      span_end: '2026-11-15'
      week_start: '2026-11-08'

  expect:

      prior_avg_interest: 40.0
      pct_change: 62.5
- name: terms_partial_week_is_unavailable
  model: fct_day_off_index_terms
  description: A week still filling in is left out and the change reads NULL, never a smaller number.
  overrides:
    vars:
      day_off_index_start_week: '2026-11-08'

version: 2
models:
- name: fct_day_off_index
  description: 'The Day-Off Index: the average year-over-year change, in percent, of US Google searches
    for call in sick, sick day and day off work over the configured window. One row per window, always
    carrying its per-phrase breakdown.'
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        grain:
        - index_window
        population:
          rule: One row for the configured window (vars day_off_index_*).
        assumptions:
        - decision: How the phrases combine
          chosen: plain average of the per-phrase percent changes
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: the index is the average of these 3 searches; each phrase is on its own 0-100
            scale, so changes are averaged, not interest values'
          column: day_off_index
        - decision: A phrase not yet available
          chosen: index NULL
          evidence: default
          detail: an average over fewer phrases would be a different index
          column: day_off_index
        - decision: Old index columns (study_year, release_day, per-source lifts, source counts)
          chosen: removed; the index is one row per window, no longer per study year
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: scratch everything of the old Day-Off Index and redefine it'
          column: study_year
        - decision: Old index column release_day
          chosen: removed
          evidence: request
          detail: the Thursday-lift design is retired
          column: release_day
        - decision: Old index column sources_total
          chosen: removed
          evidence: request
          detail: the Thursday-lift design is retired
          column: sources_total
        - decision: Old index column sources_with_lift
          chosen: removed
          evidence: request
          detail: the Thursday-lift design is retired
          column: sources_with_lift
        - decision: Old index column google_trends_lift
          chosen: removed
          evidence: request
          detail: the Thursday-lift design is retired
          column: google_trends_lift
        - decision: Old index column bluesky_lift
          chosen: removed
          evidence: request
          detail: the Thursday-lift design is retired
          column: bluesky_lift
        - decision: Old index column reddit_lift
          chosen: removed
          evidence: request
          detail: the Thursday-lift design is retired
          column: reddit_lift
        - decision: Index grain
          chosen: one row per window (index_window), was per study year
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: one YoY comparison over a configurable window'
          column: index_window
        - decision: Breakdown travels with the index
          chosen: breakdown column on the index row
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: the index is always accompanied by its breakdown, never left to be discovered'
          column: breakdown
  columns:
  - name: index_window
    description: <current_start_week>/<current_end_week>.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: key
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: current_start_week
    description: Sunday of the first week of the current window.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: current_end_week
    description: Sunday of the last week of the current window.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: prior_start_week
    description: Sunday of the first comparison week (weeks_back earlier).
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: prior_end_week
    description: Sunday of the last comparison week.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: weeks
    description: Weeks in each window.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
          unit: count
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: batch_id
    description: The Trends pull the values come from.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: phrase_count
    description: Phrases in the index.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
          unit: count
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: phrases_available
    description: Phrases whose change is available.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
          unit: count
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: day_off_index
    description: Average of the phrases' year-over-year changes, in percent (50 = searches up 50% on average).
      Always report with `breakdown`.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: 'NULL unless every phrase''s change is available: unavailable, never zero'
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: percent
  - name: breakdown
    description: Every phrase's change, e.g. 'call in sick +40.4% · day off work +73.4% · sick day +36.4%'.
      Report it with the index, every time.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
unit_tests:
- name: index_is_average_with_breakdown
  model: fct_day_off_index
  description: The index is the plain average of the phrase changes and carries every phrase in breakdown.
  given:
  - input: ref('fct_day_off_index_terms')
    rows:
    - term: sick day
      batch_id: b1
      current_start_week: '2026-11-01'
      current_end_week: '2026-11-08'
      prior_start_week: '2025-11-02'
      prior_end_week: '2025-11-09'
      weeks: 2
      pct_change: 30.0
    - term: call in sick
      batch_id: b1
      current_start_week: '2026-11-01'
      current_end_week: '2026-11-08'
      prior_start_week: '2025-11-02'
      prior_end_week: '2025-11-09'
      weeks: 2
      pct_change: 10.0
  expect:
    rows:
    - index_window: 2026-11-01/2026-11-08
      phrase_count: 2
      phrases_available: 2
      day_off_index: 20.0
      breakdown: call in sick +10.0% · sick day +30.0%
- name: index_unavailable_when_a_phrase_is
  model: fct_day_off_index
  description: 'One phrase unavailable: the index is NULL and the breakdown says which.'
  given:
  - input: ref('fct_day_off_index_terms')
    rows:
    - term: call in sick
      batch_id: b1
      current_start_week: '2026-11-01'
      current_end_week: '2026-11-08'
      prior_start_week: '2025-11-02'
      prior_end_week: '2025-11-09'
      weeks: 2
      pct_change: 10.0
    - term: sick day
      batch_id: b1
      current_start_week: '2026-11-01'
      current_end_week: '2026-11-08'
      prior_start_week: '2025-11-02'
      prior_end_week: '2025-11-09'
      weeks: 2
      pct_change: null
  expect:
    rows:
    - phrases_available: 1
      day_off_index: null
      breakdown: call in sick +10.0% · sick day not yet available
